scripts.build:helpers: npm run build:fm-helper && npm run build:speech-helper
scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-dev-app.js && npm run build:speech-helper && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE CANDER_URL=http://localhost:3000 .dev/Cander.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron .
scripts.start: node scripts/prepare-dev-app.js && npm run build:speech-helper && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE .dev/Cander.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron .
scripts.pack: npm run build:helpers && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build:helpers && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.dist:unsigned: npm run build:helpers && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cander uses the microphone for dictation and voice chat.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Cander turns your speech into text for dictation and voice chat.
